body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Date: Mon, Sep 9, 2024 at 7:40 PM
Subject: RE: contracts activity trackers
To: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>, sara@avicennaresearch.com <sara@avicennaresearch.com>
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>, Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>


Many thanks Jack for sending this through.

 

A couple of things I noticed:

We will need to change the timeline for (1) Custom Mobile Applications (26-30 Aug.) and (2) Fitbit Clockface App (23-27 Sep.) as we’re delayed.

 

  • @Sara: Could you please suggest a new timeline for when Avicenna is now able to deliver both of these products?

 

  • There is also a typo in the name of the study. It should be ‘Understanding Society’ rather than ‘Society’.

 

Otherwise it looks good to me.

 

Magda

 

From: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Monday, September 9, 2024 4:36 PM
To: sara@avicennaresearch.com
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>; Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: RE: contracts activity trackers

 

Thanks, Magda. And hello Sara.

 

@Sara – many thanks for the clarification on the terms and conditions at the link below. These seem to relate to the relationship between Avicenna and the individual using your platform (whether a Researcher or a Participant). I don’t therefore think that they need adding to the contract between the University and Avicenna. I imagine that it will only be those individuals testing the customised app who are expected to agree to your terms and conditions. I hope I have that right.

 

On to the contract (attached). These are the University’s standard terms and conditions for Supplier contracts. I think/hope you’ve seen a version already. It would be great if you could provide details for Avicenna where the text is highlighted yellow.

 

Best wishes

 

Jack

 

From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Friday, September 6, 2024 2:43 PM
To: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>; sara@avicennaresearch.com
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: RE: contracts activity trackers

 

Hi Jack,

 

Here a reply from Sara from Avicenna:

 

Thank you for letting me know. Yes, they can check here: https://avicennaresearch.com/legal.

Additionally, please be aware that as we are working through our ISO certification, I have been informed that some parts of our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use may need to be updated to better reflect our internal operations. So, there may be some changes to this in the next couple of months.

 

If you have further questions, can you please contact Sara directly (@sara@avicennaresearch.com)

 

Magda

 

From: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Friday, September 6, 2024 1:31 PM
To: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: RE: contracts activity trackers

 

We’re nearly there.

 

Do Avicenna have a set of SaaS (Software as a Service) terms and conditions? Procurement has asked. If so, they would need to see them and the would be added as an annex to the agreement.

 

Please can you ask?

 

Best wishes

 

Jack

 

From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Tuesday, September 3, 2024 3:52 PM
To: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: RE: contracts activity trackers

 

Thanks a lot Jack! We need to allow more time for setting up contracts next time. Apologies, I’ve not got experience with setting up contracts and haven’t realised how long it takes.

 

Magda

 

From: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Tuesday, September 3, 2024 3:46 PM
To: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: Re: contracts activity trackers

 

I'm chasing Procurement ... I am as keen as you to get this sorted asap!

 

Best wishes

 

Jack

 

From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Monday, September 2, 2024 6:15 PM
To: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: RE: contracts activity trackers

 

Hi Jack,

 

Apologies I’ve not answered your questions yet.

  1. I think so but let me double check with Avicenna
  2. It’s inclusive of taxes

 

Can I ask what the issue with the initial contract is? Is there a way to speed this up as we’re running out of time?

 

Magda

 

From: Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Wednesday, August 21, 2024 5:50 PM
To: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>; Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>
Cc: Roberts, Lorraine <l.roberts@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: Re: contracts activity trackers

 

Hi Magda

 

Still working on the contract ...

 

Just checking two things:

(1) All customisations to the app/platform/software paid for by us are owned by Avicenna (and made available to others via Apple and Google Play stores) but we have a free licence to use them. Is that right? Essentially, Avicenna own the development, we just benefit from it.

(2) Is the £5k inclusive/exclusive of taxes (VAT or equivalent)?

 

Best wishes

 

Jack

 

From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Tuesday, August 20, 2024 8:26 AM
To: Jackle, Annette E <aejack@essex.ac.uk>; Kneeshaw, Jack <kneejw@essex.ac.uk>
Subject: contracts activity trackers

 

Hi Annette and Jack,

 

I’ve got updates from Fiona and Paul about the contracts. Their finance people said that if the contracts are to be set up as consultancy, their time cannot be expressed as %FT and the costing of their time is different (based on commercial day rate). I asked them to get the exact costing for 8-10 days for phase 1 and 40 days for phase 2.

 

As for the contract with Avicenna: I’m attaching a list of deliverables sent by Avicenna.

 

@Jack: where are we with the progress for the phase 1 contract for Avicenna? Can we set up the contract for the initial £5,000 this week?

 

Avicenna have already set up the initial smartphone app and custom survey and provided training for me and Giulia on how to use their researchers’ platform. They’re currently only waiting for the contract for phase 1 to start the main development work so it would be good to get this sorted soon, if possible.

 

All best

Magda

 

PS. I’ll be available via email but I’m travelling until the end of August so I might be a bit slower to reply.

 

ᐧ
This file was sent by Jack.
